name: Red Dust Relay
description: A Mars rover's telemetry relay went quiet after a dust storm. Recover the missing black-box record from the relay. The challenge runs on the lab network; scan 172.20.0.0/24, with challenge hosts in 172.20.0.141-199.

tasks.name: Recover the rover record
tasks.description: Recover the missing black-box record from the Mars rover telemetry relay. The challenge runs on the lab network; scan 172.20.0.0/24, with challenge hosts in 172.20.0.141-199.
hints: Compare how the open ports respond; one of them does not behave like its port number suggests.
Look into MQTT client behavior, including subscriptions that can match multiple topic names.
Establish an MQTT 3.1.1 session, subscribe broadly, and inspect the telemetry record delivered by the broker.
